title: The order changes everything
lines: Grant access, then revoke it; reverse those steps, and the right answer changes.
Meta-Rational Pragmatics proposes AI that finds what it cannot distinguish and builds a tested way to handle it.
The same events can lead to opposite decisions when a system forgets their order.

title: What an answer forgets
lines: This research proposal uses that simple failure to ask what an AI needs to remember.
It explores how an agent might find what it missed and learn a reliable way to keep it.
Examples include permissions, documents, and software; the proposed abilities still need testing.
